text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,255.05, up 0.84% for the day and 6.07% over the last five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 0.90% (5‑day gain 5.59%). Advances outpaced declines (355 vs 134) giving a breadth score of 73, labelled “HEALTHY”. Both indices remain well above their 20‑day (≈80.6% of stocks) and 50‑day moving averages, indicating a firm uptrend.  

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹12,563 cr today and a 5‑day total of ₹55,784 cr, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold ₹8,435 cr today (5‑day net ‑₹35,732 cr). The FII streak is now 10 days of buying versus eight days of DII selling. Sector breadth shows PSU banks, capital markets and auto among the leading groups, whereas media, pharma and IT are weakening. Options data point to a Nifty “max‑pain” around 25,100, a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 0.77, and resistance walls at 26,000 (call) and 24,500 (put).  

Watch the next session for reactions around the Nifty pivot points: support at 25,092, pivot at 25,258 and resistance at 25,421. Bank Nifty’s key levels are 60,314 (S1), 60,854 (P) and 61,332 (R1). Market moves may be influenced by upcoming CPI data, FII buying trends and any profit‑booking signals from the recent rally. (PCR = put‑call ratio, a measure of option‑side bias.)
